sources.title: Manage Switches via the Omada Controller
Omada SDN Controller User Guide - Configure the Network

notes: Static Route, OSPF, VRF, routed VLAN interfaces and routing-table views must not be assumed from product-family naming.
The 6.1.0 switch guide explicitly marks VRF and OSPF as available only for certain models.
Controller functions may vary by region, controller type/version and device model.

static_route.controller_path: Devices > Device List > switch > Manage Device > Config > Routing > Static Route

ospf.boundary: Capability recorded for L3-scope gating; task 4.17 does not authorize unsourced model-wide OSPF deployment.

safety_gates: Snapshot the active routing table and management path before mutation.
Reject a route when the next hop is not provably reachable through an intended connected path.
Reject management/default-route changes without an independent recovery path.
Do not treat controller Apply/accepted state as operational PASS.
Do not create overlapping or broader routes unless precedence and rollback are explicitly understood.

pass_requires: expected route present in routing table
positive traffic test for intended destination
negative test showing unrelated traffic is not diverted

rollback.rule: Restore the exact pre-change route set and L3 feature state, then re-read the routing table and prove management and representative data-plane reachability before persistence.
